text:
tess: Kicking off Silverline case study. Need a 20s quote, a 10m interview clip, plus 3 social caption variants (numeric, conservative, test for A/B). Target publish: Aug 2. Can we record next Wed?

omar: I ran Silverline benchmarks. Median cost improvement = 3.3x on their checkout workload (30k sample). Happy to attach the CSV + short method blurb.

li: Legal checklist: signed release before publish, quote approval before social, and explicit methodology link if we use numbers. Post proposed quote text and I'll quick-redline.

noa: I'll draft three captions: (A) uses "~3.3x" with link, (B) avoids numbers, (C) uses "3x+" shorthand for paid ads. Also prep short transcript snippets for accessibility captions.

jeff: Lead routing: webinar RSVPs -> SFDC Campaign 'Silverline Launch Aug' -> SDR queue 'E-Com MidMarket'. Paid ads -> demo form; organic -> webinar. Add hidden fields for utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, ad_paid_flag. Also want a 3-email SDR nurture sequence triggered on registration.

publish-bot: Intake asset-44211 created. Required tasks: book recording, signed release, quote approval, upload benchmark + method, UTM + SFDC mapping, caption/transcript, A/B caption test setup.

tess: Draft quote: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by over 3x and let us roll out checkout features faster."

li: Legal prefers conservative wording and a short tie to the benchmark. Suggest: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~3.3x and helped us ship checkout features faster." If Research uploads the CSV and methods, we can approve. Also request embargo window note if this is pre-announced to partners.

omar: Uploading report now: https://drive.redwood/reports/silverline-benchmark.csv. Methodology blurb: "30k-request sample, median per-request inference cost, identical model config across baselines." Paste one-liner on landing page and link to report.

noa: Noted on embargo. We should include a short callout for localization: Spanish captions and a one-sentence localized quote. I'll draft L10n copy and accessibility captions.
jeff: For SFDC mapping: set CampaignMemberStatus='Registered', and add custom fields utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, ad_paid_flag. I'll attach the 3-email sequence to the intake ticket.

publish-bot: Added A/B test setup task: caption-A (numeric), caption-B (conservative), traffic split 50/50. Track CTR and demo conversions.

tess: Proposed recording: Wed 7/20 9:00am PT. 25m block (5m tech, 20m interview). Who needs calendar invite?

noa: I'll run the interview and bring caption drafts.

li: I'll review the release if quote + benchmark link are posted by EOD today.

omar: All uploaded.

tess: Great  locking time, attaching pre-interview brief, release form, UTM spec, and A/B caption plan to asset-44211. Will tag Ops for SFDC mapping. Thanks! :sparkles:
